purpose: Make the current endogenous/exogenous boundary explicit and machine-checkable for every variable appearing in the qualitative feedback registry, without converting candidate topology into active endogenous structure.

current_state.interpretation: Coverage completeness means every registered feedback node has an explicit current classification. It does not mean the behavioural boundary is scientifically resolved.

variables.classification_basis: An exact observed credit_flow reference target exists, but observed-target status does not establish whether the integrated feedback node will ultimately be endogenous, exogenous or imposed during a specific partial-model experiment.
